text:
Alice R.: Heads up — external pentest scheduled 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-12. Need to lock down staging snapshot, RBAC freeze window, KMS access, and an evidence bundle. Who can own remediation tracker and retest calendar?

Ben I.: I can own KMS/evidence bucket. Plan: ephemeral role via kms-proxy + presigned S3 uploads. TTL 4h. I'll publish steps.

Ben I.: Example presign (for reference):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/staging-snapshots/20260505.tar.gz --expires-in 14400
```

Carlos S.: I'll handle logs and snapshots. Need to know which log groups to include and sampling window. Recommend full-traffic 1h capture at start of test + 30m tail.

Deepa P.: For RBAC, are we doing a temporary role whitelist or full policy branching? Prefer whitelist to avoid lasting changes. Short runbook: create ephemeral assessor role, tag sessions, monitor.

Alice R.: Agree whitelist. We should also require MFA on ephemeral sessions and rotate keys after evidence upload. Deepa — can you draft runbook steps? Keep them minimal.

Deepa P.: Draft in thread:
1) Create role `assessor_ephemeral` with scoped read-only to staging resources.
2) Apply session tag `pt-assessor=<vendor>`.
3) Grant kms:Decrypt for evidence bucket via key policy just-in-time.
4) Remove role bindings after 24h.

Fiona L.: Legal: need redaction checklist before handing logs. PI/credentials MUST be removed. Can we automate scrubbing pipeline? If not, include manual redaction step and sign-off.

Ben I.: We have a scrub script but it misses some env vars. Carlos — can you run `log-scrub --pattern "SECRET|TOKEN" --dry-run` on exported logs before packaging?

Carlos S.: Yup. Will run dry-run and post findings. Also will generate CloudTrail snapshot and KMS key usage report.

Alice R.: Assignments so far: Ben -> KMS + presigned evidence bucket; Carlos -> logs + snapshot; Deepa -> RBAC runbook + oncall rollback; Fiona -> redaction sign-off. Need one person for remediation tracker + weekly stand.

Evan: I'll take remediation tracker and run the weekly 30m stand. Will create GH project and link issues.

deploy-bot: snapshot created for staging: snapshot-2026-05-05-09:12 (id: snap-pt-324987).

Alice R.: Great. Last ask — everyone please add their contact and available retest windows to the calendar invite I just sent (two candidate weeks: 2026-05-17 and 2026-05-24). We'll lock after vendor availability confirmed.

Ben I.: One more — KMS policy snippet to allow assessor decrypt only for evidence path:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-pt-evidence",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:purpose": "pt-evidence"}}
}
```

Deepa P.: If vendor requests SSH into staging, deny. We won't allow direct SSH; use recorded bastion with session recording.

Alice R.: Noted. Thanks everyone — I'll convert this into an ops checklist and post in the evidence folder. Ping here if anything changes.
